digest.component_or_area: pytest temp directory management and nested session isolation
propositions: Nested pytest children launched without explicit --basetemp join the user-global numbered temp root and may delete unrelated cleanup-eligible directories during session finish.
tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py::test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active executes a mixed-module child without --basetemp, allowing it to clean unrelated shared temp trees.
tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py::test_repro_module_passes_standalone executes a standalone child without --basetemp, allowing it to clean unrelated shared temp trees.
Parent pytest processes must pass unique --basetemp values derived from tmp_path to each executing nested child to keep cleanup local to the parent fixture.
Pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers cleanup for the numbered root; pytest_sessionfinish only skips cleanup when _basetemp is None.
